# TargetedHistory&lt;TKey, TPixel&gt;

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Editing` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public sealed class TargetedHistory<TKey, TPixel>
```

One undo/redo history across many surfaces: each step remembers WHICH surface it edited, so undoing restores that surface and says which one it was.

**Type parameters**

- `TKey` - Identifies a surface.
- `TPixel` - The pixel the surfaces store.

## Remarks

The same contract as [`EditHistory<TPixel>`](Nfty.Core.Editing.EditHistory-1.md) (a no-op edit is not recorded, a new edit clears redo), keyed. The caller resolves a key to its surface at undo time, so surfaces may be created lazily and outlive whatever the page is currently showing.

- `cmd` (`IEditCommand<TPixel>`) - The edit.
- `surface` (`IEditSurface<TPixel>`) - The surface to edit.
